Tooltip_Zomboxolone: Treats the zombie virus, but cannot cure it. Gives you more time before you turn.
Tooltip_Zomboxivir: Inhaled vapor in a glass tube, cures a zombie virus infection.
Tooltip_Zomboxycycline: Prevents the zombie virus from infecting you for 24 hours.
Tooltip_ViralTestingKit: Contains up to 10 test strips used to test for the Knox virus.
Tooltip_ViralTestingStrip: Test strip used to test for the Knox virus.
Tooltip_ViralTestingStripPositive: A used Knox virus test strip. Whoever used it is going to have a bad time.
Tooltip_ViralTestingStripNegative: A used Knox virus test strip. It found no traces of the virus in its user.
